memory: I retain: Ra <0.05 µm seats, burr removal, and kinematic Kelvin triplet give excellent concentric contact. Single particles can cause large excursions; calibrated tests show clean-seat threshold ≈20 µm for >0.20 µm error; residue reduces threshold to ≈15 µm. Filtered N2 alone insufficient for adhered debris. Best current cleaning: IPA low-lint swab + N2 blow + 40× inspection. Ultrasonic cleaning effective but incompatible with phenolic parts. Current position: adopt the IPA/N2 inspection protocol and next quantify adhesion conditions that let 15–20 µm particles stick.
openQuestion: What adhesion force or residue thickness causes 15–20 µm particles to adhere and produce >0.20 µm excursions over repeated seatings?
